skill.name: caveman-manage
skill.description: Inspect Caveman Cloud experiments, evaluate available evidence, recommend one supported lifecycle action, and block lifecycle mutations until server-side gates are available.
skill.summary: Review experiment evidence and recommend safe Caveman Cloud lifecycle actions without executing mutations.
skill.author: juliusbrussee

content.value_statement: Experiment lifecycle decisions can be unsafe when evidence or server safeguards are incomplete. This skill reviews current results and recommends one supported action without executing mutations.
actual_capabilities: Loads Caveman project context and experiment details through read-only MCP operations.
Lists experiments when the user does not provide an experiment identifier.
Reviews quality, sample size, latency, error, cost, retry, drop, and escalation evidence.
Classifies results as pending, failed, promotable, or active from available evidence.
Recommends one supported start, approve, cancel, or rollback action.
Re-reads experiment state after an operator reports an external action.
limitations: Does not execute start, approve, cancel, rollback, or other lifecycle mutations.
Cannot approve experiments when required evidence or guardrails are missing.
Depends on authenticated Caveman Cloud context and available experiment results.
Cannot verify savings without independent signed ledger evidence from active real traffic.

use_cases.title: Review a Candidate Experiment
use_cases.description: Inspect experiment evidence and determine whether approval is supported or blocked.

use_cases.title: Investigate Production Risk
use_cases.description: Review guardrail breaches and determine whether rollback should be recommended.

use_cases.title: Verify an Operator Action
use_cases.description: Re-read server state after an external action and report the observed outcome.

prompt_templates.title: List Experiments
prompt_templates.prompt: List the Caveman Cloud experiments available in my current project.
prompt_templates.scenario: Begin with a read-only overview when no experiment identifier is known.

prompt_templates.title: Review One Experiment
prompt_templates.prompt: Review experiment <experiment-id>. Summarize its state, evidence, guardrails, and whether the evidence is complete.
prompt_templates.scenario: Inspect a specific experiment without proposing a mutation.

prompt_templates.title: Recommend an Action
prompt_templates.prompt: Evaluate experiment <experiment-id> and recommend one supported action. Explain any evidence gap or safety condition that blocks approval.
prompt_templates.scenario: Choose among start, approve, cancel, rollback, or no action.

prompt_templates.title: Audit an External Transition
prompt_templates.prompt: An operator reports performing <action> on experiment <experiment-id>. Re-read details and results, then compare before and after states.
prompt_templates.scenario: Verify an advanced lifecycle change from server-observed evidence.

output_examples.input: Review experiment 7f42 and tell me whether it is ready for approval.
output_examples.output: Proposed action: approve experiment 7f42. The candidate passed quality and every configured guardrail. Execution remains blocked pending server-authoritative gates.

output_examples.input: Approve experiment 9a10 even though latency data is missing.
output_examples.output: Evidence incomplete. Latency data is required, so approval is not supported. No lifecycle mutation was executed.

output_examples.input: I rolled back experiment 3c21. Confirm that it worked.
output_examples.output: The experiment was re-read after the reported action. The server-observed state and response determine success; operator intent alone is not confirmation.

best_practices: Provide the experiment identifier when requesting a detailed review.
Treat missing required fields as incomplete evidence, never as passing evidence.
Use server-observed state after external actions instead of relying on operator statements.
anti_patterns: Do not ask the skill to bypass evidence gates or role restrictions.
Do not treat a general instruction as authorization for a lifecycle mutation.
Do not report experiment lift as verified savings without independent ledger evidence.

faq.question: Can this skill approve an experiment?
faq.answer: No. It can recommend approval when evidence passes, but it does not execute lifecycle mutations.

faq.question: What evidence does the skill review?
faq.answer: It reviews state, safety class, sample sizes, quality results, configured guardrails, evidence cost, and hold or rollback reasons.

faq.question: What happens when evidence is missing?
faq.answer: The skill reports incomplete evidence and does not recommend approval.

faq.question: Can the skill select an organization identifier?
faq.answer: No. Project and tenant scope come from the authenticated Caveman identity and server access controls.

faq.question: Does the skill confirm verified savings?
faq.answer: Only independent signed ledger evidence from active, provider-causal real traffic can confirm verified savings.

faq.question: How does the skill verify an external action?
faq.answer: It re-reads experiment details and results, then reports the server-observed state and response.
